title: Broggy & Blittens 🐾
description: From Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story, Broggy and his loyal Blittens arrive in Minecraft with a fully remade resource pack! 🎮
body:
A classic returns… better than ever.

From Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story, Broggy and his loyal Blittens arrive in Minecraft with a fully remade resource pack! 🎮

This pack includes:

🐉 Broggy, replacing the Bully with a completely updated model and textures
🐾 Blittens, replacing Shellslugs, faithfully recreated as Broque Monsieur’s beloved companions

✨ What’s new in this remake:

🎨 Improved textures based on the original game by AlphaDream
🎞️ New animations, including:
Idle
Movement
Attack animations
🔧 Overall polish and accuracy compared to the original version

I really felt the need to remake this one — the previous version didn’t meet the quality I wanted. It lacked proper texturing and some very important base animations.

Now, this version finally does justice to the characters… and of course, includes the fan-favorite Blittens 🐾💛

Hope you enjoy this remake as much as I enjoyed bringing it back to life! 🚀
